pieces.Text: A skirmisher learns to be more maneuverable while wearing light or no armor. He gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armor and while carrying no more than a light load. Anything that causes the skirmisher to lose his Dexterity bonus to AC also causes the skirmisher to lose this dodge bonus.
In addition, a skirmisher gains an enhancement bonus of +
feet to his base speed. This benefit applies only when he is wearing no armor or light armor, and when he is carrying no more than a light load.
